title: Checkpoint: the hostile-reviewer Session
prompt:
Implement `static final class Session` + helper:
1. Constructor `Session(List<String> events)` — defensively copies.
2. `events()` returns an unmodifiable view; `add(String e)` mutates internal state only.
3. `String describe()` returns `"Session[n]"` with n = current event count.
4. `static String safeTrace()` — creates a Session from a mutable list, mutates that external list afterwards, then returns the Session's `describe()` value.
The tests simulate all three hostile reviewers.

tests.name: survives outside-in mutation
tests.hint: Copy the list in the constructor.

tests.name: survives inside-out mutation
describe tracks internal adds
tests.hint: describe reads the internal list size.

tests.name: safeTrace immune to post-ctor edits
tests.hint: safeTrace must copy before the external list is mutated.
